name: contract-runner-discovery
goal: Discover exact runner case identities and inherited disabled state without inventing group tests

evidence: Discovery treats describe.skip as a case and loses suite-qualified identities. Nested cases can falsely count as enabled coverage or collide across suites.
The existing scan case covered aliases, direct skips and computed registrations only. Strengthened that same case with active and skipped nested describes; suite remains two tests.
